title: Approval-triggered rerun gate: rerun-workflow-run.yml relies on the rerun.yml run concluding success, so non-approving reviews must leave the trigger job skipped, not successful
answers: Why does a review comment or change request not trigger the rerun workflow now that the artifact is gone?
If I add a job to rerun.yml, will non-approving reviews start a rerun?
How is the approval check enforced for the rerun workflow after the PR-number artifact was removed?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/rerun.yml (single job approved, gated by `if: github.event.review.state == 'approved'` and an allowed-author check) feeds .github/workflows/rerun-workflow-run.yml, which only proceeds when `workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'`.
Rule: The approval check is now carried by the run conclusion. A run whose only job is skipped by its `if` concludes `skipped`, which fails the `success` gate, so comments, change requests, and unauthorized reviews do not rerun. Keep the approval condition in the job `if`; do not add an unconditional job or a step that exits 0 to the rerun.yml run, since that would make the run conclude `success` for non-approvals.
Symptom: Without the artifact (which previously failed to download for non-approvals), a non-approving review could have triggered the rerun; the gate on run conclusion is what prevents it.
Constraints: Verified by a reviewer against a real run (copilot/update-rerun-workflow-order, run 33895204959), where the all-skipped run concluded `skipped`. Holds only while rerun.yml has exactly one job. Adding a second job requires re-checking this gate.
applies: Any change to rerun.yml triggers or its job conditions that feed the approval-triggered rerun workflow.
says: Review comments or change requests no longer trigger the rerun workflow after approval
Adding a job to the approval rerun workflow makes non-approving reviews start a rerun
Approval check for the rerun workflow no longer depends on the removed PR-number artifact
search: Approval-triggered rerun gate: the rerun-workflow-run workflow proceeds only when the triggering rerun.yml run concludes success, so the approval condition must stay in the single job's if, and non-approving reviews leave it skipped. Do not add an unconditional job or an exit-0 step to rerun.yml; re-check the gate if a second job is added.
